system.story: The whole undercity on speed-dial: deals, favors, and the fixer's web.

description.value:
Origin: Street-Fixer. The connective tissue of the shadows - best where reputation and relationships rule.

The Fixer's Web

The strongest Contacts engine in the game: you start with extra contacts, cultivate them faster, and can call in a favor mid-run. You gain edges to Streetwise legwork and to negotiations framed around Freedom, Greed, and Vengeance.

Bonus skill & contact

Streetwise skill; contact: a fixer or gang lieutenant.

Fully mundane - no Veil access, no magic-erosion penalty.
